d9a54d1b:  ;
 ;Input Parameters:
 ;
 ;  DFN      = Patient Internal Entry Number
 ;  DGJTDT   = Transaction Date
 ;  DGJPARM  = Parameter Array
 ;  DGJIRTDA = IRT Internal Entry Number Array
 ;  DGJT     = Total Charges Array
 ;  DGJFLG   = Flag to Determine if Separate Bills per Occurrence
 ;  DGJTYP   = Type of Charge (i.e. OPT, SC, etc)
 ;
e80b5266: Initialize the variable DGJOUT which will be used to store the output.
aee77029: Get the value of the parameter node for the current division from the DG PARAMETER file (#40.8). This value is stored in the variable DGJPARM.
7d4752d2: If the parameter node value is 0 (false), quit the routine.
e0cd6ac8: Set the DGJTYP variable to the internal entry number of the 'DISCHARGE SUMMARY' entry in the VAS SERVICE/SECTION file (#393.3). If DGJTYP is already defined, use that value instead.

33897e25: If DGJIRTDA (IRT Data Array) is defined and an entry exists in the VAS SERVICE/SECTION file (#393) for that IRT, and either there is no 'DT' node for that entry or the 'DT' node exists but has a null value, set the DGJFLG flag to 1 and quit the routine.
5446a70f: Quit if no data or invalid entry reference number.
7b552386: Loop through all 'B' cross-reference entries for the patient, and quit if the user has indicated a desire to exit (DGJOUT is true).
993c1182: If the entry matches the type and admission number, set the DGJOUT flag to quit the loop and return the entry reference number.
79eea9f6: If the required variables are not set, add them and quit.
4fd1a771: Quit the routine.

f53d4995: 
 ;Set up variables for adding a new entry
 ;DIC = file number
 ;DLAYGO = file number for laygo
 ;DR = input template
 ;DIE = file number for die call
 ;DGJT9, DGJT10, DGJTSP, DGJTSV, DGJX, DGJY, DGJTEV, DGJTWARD are work variables
9d79c912: Set DGJTSV to ward's service if a ward was passed in, otherwise null.
cb8b184a: If DGJT("WARD") is defined, set DGJTSV to the service for that ward lookup value, otherwise set DGJTSV to 1.

48147690: If DGJTSV is null or empty string, set it to 0. Then set DGJTSV to the next entry in ^DG(393.1,"AC") for the current DGJTSV value. If no such entry exists, set DGJTSV to the first entry in ^DG(393.1,"AC",0).
cd564392: Set DGJTSP to the 0th node of the latest Transfer in Date/Time multiple entry for the current admission and patient.
93254169: Set DGJX and DGJY to 8 and 2 respectively. Call the DOC tag to set X. Set DGJT9 to X and reset X to null string.
dd8aac1d: If parameter #3 in DGJPARM is true, set DGJX to 19 and DGJY to 4. Call the DOC tag to set X and store the value in DGJT10.
35b53276: Set DGJTEV to DGJTDT if it is not null, otherwise set it to the admission date/time from DGJT("ADDT"). Set DGJTWARD to the ward location from file 42 for the current ward in DGJT("WARD").
56cb13c3: Look up the entry for the current patient in the HEALTH FACTORS file (#393) and create a new entry if one does not exist.
87a7e99c: Check if the visit date is valid and quit if not.
f941e208: Acquire a lock on the entry being updated. Quit if unable to obtain the lock.

561b49a0: Set the fields to be edited with new values for type, event, admission number, ward, division, time stamp, treating specialty, time/procedure code 9, time/procedure code 10, time/procedure code 9 again, and 'was admission determined'.
872c1bc2: Call the FileMan ^DIE routine to edit the entry.
2dcf4627: Release the lock on the entry.
ea0f9b67: Set a flag indicating the update was successful and quit.

471fca2e: Block comment describing the EDIT subroutine.

The subroutine edits an existing entry in the VAS(393 global. It takes several input parameters: DGJIRTDA (the internal entry number), DGJVDD (unknown), DGJVDB (unknown), DGJVDT (unknown), DGJVTB (unknown), and DGJPARM (unknown). The routine acquires a lock on the entry to prevent simultaneous updates.
8f6c290b: Acquire a lock on the entry being updated. Quit if unable to obtain the lock.
4509d56f: Build DR string
98e6fbb5: Call FILE^DIE to update record with new values
f6de194c: Lock the record globally.
665ab386: Exit if no record is found.
a75cd078: Lock the record locally and quit if unable to obtain lock.
ebc89854: Generate FileMan data deletion syntax.
0f8d0bb3: Call FileMan to update the record and store result in STAT1.
947cf24a: Release the global lock on the record.
5b79313f: Exit routine.
d5e9397a: Lock the record locally and quit if unable to obtain lock.
e214345a: Generate FileMan data update syntax from passed values.
b69017fc: Store IRT entry number in DA, set to file 393 DIC, and run FileMan DIE update.
334566d6: Release lock on IRT entry after editing.
3733bbe6: Exit routine.
2f3784a3: Initialize local variables.
7450ebc8: Get 'DT' node for IRT entry - contains status information.
1d2a3221: If DT node is empty, set INCOMPLETE status and branch to STAT label.
